reviews.title: Ai took over
reviews.text:
Chegg used to be a staple throughout my college years, helping me when even my professors couldn’t. After some time away, I came back only to find that the platform has completely changed—and not for the better.

AI has taken over, and the expert help that made Chegg valuable is essentially gone. You can no longer submit images of your questions, which was one of the most useful features. If your exact question isn’t already in Chegg’s system, you’re basically out of luck—and even the AI often falls short.

I’m currently taking biochemistry, and every time I tried to get help, I kept hitting dead ends. I couldn’t understand why my images wouldn’t upload, only to find out (after calling customer service) that the feature had been removed entirely. That was incredibly frustrating, especially when my professor wasn’t available and I needed real support.

Chegg used to feel like a hidden gem, but now it just feels like another generic AI platform. In trying to keep up with trends, they’ve lost what actually made them useful—real human help. Students and experts alike deserved better than this shift, especially at $20 a month.

I cancelled my subscription immediately.

reviews.title: Do NOT use anything CHEGG
reviews.text:
I spent quite a bit of time creating literally 1000 Flashcards with which to study.  You can imagine how long it took to create both Front and Back of these cards, only to have CHEGG discontinue the app I was using and then offer a replacement.

Okay, no problem.  I have an account, and all my hard work and tremendous time spent should be saved, right…?  Wrong.  

I have been unable to access my cards ever since they discontinued the old app.  I cannot even sign in!  When I tried I was prompted to change my password.  Okay, I’ll do that.  Then, once I changed my password, the app would not allow me to sign in.  I kept receiving a message that said “There is already an account with that username/email.’  Yeah, no kidding — It’s ME!!!  So I tried both my old password AND the one they just required me to change it into.  I keep getting the same message.

So if your goal is to spend HOURS creating flashcards, only to lose them all, by all means create an account with this dysfunctional app.  But if your plan is to spend your time studying, do yourself a favor — DO NOT USE THIS APP!!!

Consider yourself warned.
